limitations: Curated partial key and articulation coverage; not complete upstream libraries.
No invented loops; only guitar uses explicit source SFZ loops; other finite recordings may end during held notes.
No round-robin, release-trigger, pedal or SFZ modulation equivalence.
Source offsets/cents must be applied during offthread preparation; loop ends are exclusive.
Original WAV/FLAC bytes retained; map key spans/dynamic simplification/headroom are VibeRa curation.
FM electric piano is a recorded TX81Z FM-keyboard timbre, not a Rhodes or acoustic piano.
Listening and full engine/runtime qualification remain separate.
